source.title: Technical Report NOS CS 33: NGOFS skill assessment
source.validation_period: 2010-10-13 to 2011-02-14 for mb0101 Mobile Bay Buoy M

station.name: Mobile Bay Buoy M
station.role: historic observed current station near Mobile Bay entrance; substantially closer to bay-mouth exchange than the current 2026 upper-bay PORTS validation stations

reported_hindcast_metrics.note: NOAA report labels D-d as direction comparison and DFC/DEC as flood/ebb current-direction comparisons; these are historical NGOFS hindcast metrics, not NGOFS2 2026 nowcast skill.

interpretation: Historical NOAA skill studies show that the operational-model lineage can reproduce substantial current variability at the Mobile Bay entrance, but flood/ebb direction errors of roughly 41-44 degrees remain material. This is consistent with the new Sep 2026 PORTS comparison: use NGOFS2 as useful oscillatory/transport-timing guidance, but do not treat raw model vectors as precise Point Clear shoreline-normal observed transport. The historical result improves the evidence base for bounding model trust but does not validate current NGOFS2 at Point Clear.
guardrails: Historic NGOFS and current NGOFS2 are not the same model version; no skill metric is transferred numerically to current Point Clear guidance.
mb0101 is near the bay entrance, not Point Clear shoreline contact.
Reported direction and speed metrics come from NOAA technical reports and are not recomputed in this research artifact.
No production feature, weight, threshold, or forecast logic changed.
